definitions.full: H2838. chashuq [ חָשׁוּק ] noun [masculine] fillet or ring clasping ( binding ) a pillar of the tabernacle, only plural suffix חֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם Exod 27:10 5 t.; חֲשׁוּקַיהֶם 38:12 , 17 ; those of the pillars at door of tabernacle ( הָאֹהֶל ) were overlaid with gold 36:38 ; those of the pillars of the court with silver 27:10-11 , 38:10-11 , 12 , 17 , 19 (all P), see Di on 27:10 ; > Thes and most who understand of connecting-rods , joining tops of pillars, from which curtains were hung.
